result.summary: Found 1 issue: an incorrect active tab state in the bottom navigation bar.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar highlights the 'Profile' tab as active (in green) instead of the 'Home' tab, even though the user is currently viewing the Home screen.
issues.suggestion: Update the bottom navigation bar state logic so that the 'Home' icon and label are highlighted as active when viewing the main feed, and 'Profile' is shown in the inactive grey state.
